name: Kilo Desktop
desc: Standalone desktop app holding the whole Kilo workflow in one window.
desc_zh: 把 Kilo 整套流程收进一个窗口的独立桌面应用。
solves: Jumping between the editor, the CLI and the cloud splits the work; one app carries planning, coding and review together.
solves_zh: 在编辑器、命令行和云端之间来回跳会把活儿拆散；一个应用把规划、写码和审查放在一起。
best_for: You switched from the extension and want the agent as the main window instead of a sidebar.
best_for_zh: 从插件转过来，想让智能体当主窗口而不是侧边栏。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — blog.kilo.ai directory）。 GA followed on 2026-11-17. kilo.ai/desktop returns 404, so the vendor site root is used as the entry page. 首次公开日期来源：https://blog.kilo.ai/p/desktop
